title: unused-media pre-commit hook: repo-wide media check runs via always_run so deletion-only commits are still checked
answers: Why did a commit that deletes the last doc reference to an image or GIF not trigger the unused media check?
How is the unused-media check run locally and in CI?
Where is the script that finds unused media files wired in?
How do I add another repo-wide check that does not depend on which files changed?
body:
Path: The `unused-media` hook in .pre-commit-config.yaml (stage pre-commit, language system) runs dev/find-unused-media.sh over the whole repository to find media files that no document or reference uses. CI reaches it through `pre-commit run --all-files`; the separate step in .github/workflows/lint.yml was removed.
Rule: For a filename-independent, repo-wide check, set `pass_filenames: false` and `always_run: true` on the pre-commit hook. Without `always_run`, pre-commit skips the hook when no staged file matches, and deleted paths are excluded from the candidate list, so a deletion-only commit would skip the check. Keep such checks as pre-commit hooks rather than separate workflow steps so local and CI coverage stay identical.
Symptom: A commit that removed the only reference to an existing media file passed locally with no unused-media warning, because the hook never ran.
Constraints: Applies to hooks whose result does not depend on the staged filenames. Hooks that lint specific files should keep their `files:` pattern and not use `always_run`. The hook runs the local script, so it needs dev/find-unused-media.sh to be executable and its dependencies available on the developer machine.
applies: Repo-level pre-commit hook configuration and the dev/find-unused-media.sh media check in MLflow; not for file-specific linters.
says: Deleting image references from documentation should flag the orphaned media files during commit.
The pre-commit check fails to detect unused images when only text files are deleted.
Ensure documentation media validation runs even when no new image files are staged.
Commits removing the last link to a picture pass without warning about unused files.
Flag orphaned illustrations when cleaning up doc references in a pull request.
search: The repo-wide unused-media hook in .pre-commit-config.yaml runs dev/find-unused-media.sh using pass_filenames: false and always_run: true so deletion-only commits still trigger the media check. This ensures both local pre-commit checks and CI runs via pre-commit run --all-files detect media files whose references were removed. The rule applies to filename-independent repo checks requiring an executable dev/find-unused-media.sh, and does not apply to file-specific linters using a files: pattern.
